Open the Claude Code agent view inside the VM (`claude agents`)

Usage: iso claude-agents [NAME] [ARGS]...

Arguments:
  [NAME]     Instance name (required if multiple instances exist)
  [ARGS]...  Extra arguments passed to `claude agents`

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help

If the remote TUI stops responding, type Enter, then ~. to disconnect. If your terminal remains broken afterward, run `stty sane`.
